name: Rape Gasshuku ~Hikisakareta Leotard~
original_name: レイプ合宿　～引き裂かれたレオタード～
source:
Members of the girl's rhythmic gymnastics club stay together in the club camp to train themselves for the meet. However, hoodlums are staying at the same pension and to get rid of their boredom, they start assaulting the girls.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ048263.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
女子艺术体操俱乐部的成员们一起留在俱乐部营地，为比赛进行自我训练。然而，流氓们仍然拿着同样的养老金，为了摆脱无聊，他们开始袭击女孩。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ048263.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
